name: Haru to Yuki,
source:
The small ryokan Yuki is located deep in the mountains, away from the other hotels and ryokans of the hot spring town in the Tohoku region of Japan. It has a unique system where the guests and staff are free to dress however they want on the ryokan grounds. While it is possible to bring your own clothes, there are some available for rent too. The staff also takes requests from guests on what to wear. However, it is forbidden to be naked outside of the baths, and you can’t touch the staff, as expected.

Wouldn’t you like to stay at an unusual ryokan like this?

Ah, there’s other strange things aside from the cosplays, but don’t mind it. It’s just some dead people that come for a stay, but since they possess physical bodies that can be touched, you won’t be able to tell the difference from living beings anyway. Yuki welcomes any and all guests, so please pay them a visit!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
小旅馆Yuki位于大山深处，远离日本东北地区温泉小镇的其他酒店和旅馆。它有一个独特的系统，客人和工作人员可以在旅馆内随意着装。虽然可以自带衣服，但也可以租一些衣服。工作人员还会根据客人的着装要求。不过，浴池外面是禁止裸体的，而且正如预料的那样，你不能触摸工作人员。

你不想住在这样一家不寻常的旅馆吗？

啊，除了cosplay之外还有其他奇怪的事情，不过别介意。只不过是一些死人来寄宿而已，但由于他们拥有可以触摸的肉身，所以你无论如何也无法与活人区别开来。Yuki欢迎所有的客人，所以请来参观！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~！[/url]]
